summary.text: John Paul Hott is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 85, listed with Grant County. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hott's page gives his birth date as September 23, 1969, and his birthplace as Petersburg, West Virginia, and lists a master's in administration supervision.
It lists his occupation as insurance and disposal service, names his spouse as Karen, and lists four children.
His page lists the Gideons as an affiliation.
Hott also serves on the House's Banking and Insurance, Finance, Government Organization and Rules committees.
